Later in the semester in my Bayesian Statistics course, we completed a second technical report. Using the same guidelines as the first technical report, my partner and I were asked to complete a Bayesian analysis of power plays in Mixed Doubles curling. Mixed Doubles curling is a unique variant of curling, and our professor tasked us with analyzing how using a power play impacts the odds of winning a match, and whether or not "failing" a shot further impacted the odds of winning a match. For our findings on power plays in Mixed Doubles curling, you can use the following link to [download our report](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1YdV6pBE58WyJa55yEvGpSofmCJ-c8mAs).
